title: YNotStay_GilbertAZ
description: Private resort-style retreat perfect for families and groups! Main-level king suite with spa ensuite, 3 queen bedrooms upstairs, and a kid-friendly lower level with bunks and luxury reclining couches. Open living space with a 95” TV, coffee & soda bar, plus a private casita with 2 queen bedrooms, office, kitchen, and living room. Backyard features a shallow to diving depth commercial pool with slide, grotto, mini golf, cornhole, Outdoor kitchen, fireplace, and more—pickleball court coming soon!

Additional requests: Dishes
Please bring all dishes from the outdoor kitchen into the main house.
Load any used dishes into the main house dishwasher and start the dishwasher using detergent located below the sink before you leave.
Any unwashed dishes from the casita may be left in the casita sink.
house_rules.additional_rules:
House Rules

No Parties or Events
Parties, events, gatherings, or celebrations of any kind are strictly prohibited. This includes (but is not limited to) bachelor/bachelorette parties, birthday parties, reunions, or any large group gatherings. Violation of this rule may result in immediate cancellation of the reservation without refund.

Maximum Occupancy
Only the number of guests listed on the reservation are permitted on the property at any time. Unregistered guests are not allowed.
